⚔️ FSK ELIXIR SCRAMBLE — WE NEED YOU! 🧪💀

Calling all Forsaken degenerates! It’s time to steal some buildings, collect some points, and cause a little ✨organized chaos✨.

Never played? CLUELESS? PERFECT. 😂 It’s actually super easy, and we’ll teach you! No experience required, just show up, follow directions, and try not to lick the elixir.

🔥 TEAM B: 18:00–18:30
🔥 TEAM A: 23:00–23:30

👥 20 players MAX per team!

Not ready to commit? We can put you down as a substitute! No pressure!

We don’t need professionals. We need warm bodies, questionable decision-making skills, and people willing to commit war crimes against imaginary buildings. 💀

COMMENT TEAM A, TEAM B, OR SUB!

🖤 FSK — THE FORSAKEN
Come for the chaos. Stay because we’re probably your favorite dysfunctional family.
